summary_en: Scroll Corporation will cancel 606,700 treasury shares, representing 1.75% of issued shares before cancellation, with an effective date of September 30, 2026. After cancellation, issued shares will total 34,022,500.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On September 15, 2026, Scroll Corporation announced the cancellation of 606,700 treasury shares, effective September 30, 2026. These shares represent 1.75% of the issued shares outstanding before cancellation. The treasury shares were acquired between November 5, 2025 and January 13, 2026, with the cancellation excluding shares allocated for stock-based compensation. After cancellation, the company will have 34,022,500 issued shares outstanding, with an estimated 1,107,487 treasury shares remaining (3.26% of post-cancellation issued shares).
